description: The quality-engineering contract, as data rather than as prose.
SKILL.md explains the reasoning; this file is what the scripts and the
hook read, so a gate cannot drift from its documentation by one of them
being edited and the other not. Anything with a command in it is here.
The rule this file exists to make mechanical: a change to production
behaviour arrives with the registry entry and the test that decides it,
in the same commit. Not afterwards, because afterwards is a backlog.

statuses.verified: at least one named test, no planned_in
statuses.partial: at least one named test, plus the planned_in that will finish it
statuses.planned: no test, and the planned_in that will add one
statuses.accepted_gap: a waiver with an expiry; never permitted on a critical entry

production_behaviour.why: A behaviour change with no registry entry is a behaviour nobody agreed to and nothing decides.

test_only.why: A new test that decides a requirement belongs in that requirement's verification list, or the claim and the evidence drift apart.

workflow.why: A job outside the gate's needs is a check that can fail without blocking anything.

config_schema.why: A config file that parses is not a config file that is correct.

defect_fix.why: Every production defect gets a REG-#### entry and a test that is never deleted because the problem is fixed.

security_finding.why: Every security finding gets a SEC-#### entry and a test that is never deleted because the problem is fixed.

gates.title: The registry validates against its schema
gates.why: The schema now carries the cross-field rules (status vs evidence, id prefix vs kind, critical never waived), so a tool that reads the registry without importing the loader still sees them.

gates.title: Every claimed test exists and the dependency graph is acyclic
gates.why: What JSON Schema cannot express: a renamed test must turn its claim red rather than silently passing.

gates.title: The generated traceability document is in sync
gates.why: A generated document edited by hand is a document that lies about what is verified.

gates.title: Every JSON file in the repository parses, and the schema'd ones validate
gates.why: A malformed config is discovered at startup in production otherwise.

gates.title: Every workflow ends in a gate that needs every job
gates.why: Branch protection requires checks by name, and a check that never reports satisfies the requirement by being absent.

gates.title: Production readiness is a conjunction over the registry
gates.why: Advisory during development: it reports the phases still outstanding rather than blocking work on them.

gates.title: Least privilege, SHA pinning, fork-secret isolation
gates.why: Every failure in this class is a property of configuration and invisible at runtime.

rationale: The full suite is long and the machine that decides a pull request is
the CI runner, not a laptop. A local pass proves nothing about the gate
The exception is this skill's own gates: they are seconds, they read
files rather than running the system, and catching a malformed registry
before the push is the difference between one round trip and three.

never.rule: Never mark an entry verified without a test that exists and decides it
never.why: Status is a claim about evidence. Verified with an empty verification array is the single failure this registry exists to prevent.

never.rule: Never delete a REG- or SEC- test because the problem is fixed
never.why: The test is what stops it coming back. Deleting it converts a permanent guarantee into a historical anecdote.

never.rule: Never edit a generated document by hand
never.why: docs/quality/REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md comes from the registry. Edit the registry and regenerate; CI checks with --check.

never.rule: Never widen a gate to make a change pass
never.why: If a rule is wrong, argue it in the diff and change the rule deliberately. Loosening a threshold to get green is how a gate becomes decorative.

never.rule: Never add a workflow job without adding it to that workflow's gate needs
never.why: A job outside needs can fail while the required check stays green.
